sets.relationshipLabel: a container and what it holds
sets.explanation: A bin holds grain and a trough holds mash — each pair is a container paired with its typical contents.

sets.relationshipLabel: an action and the action that undoes it
sets.explanation: To stock is undone by selling, just as to fill is undone by emptying — each pair is an action and its reversal.

sets.relationshipLabel: a raw or planted form becomes a processed or grown thing
sets.explanation: A bulb becomes a flower through growth, and alfalfa becomes a pellet through processing — each pair turns a starting material into its end product.

sets.relationshipLabel: earlier and later moment across a span
sets.explanation: An egg is laid before it hatches, and a flower buds before it blooms — each pair marks the start and end of the same natural span.
